headline: 1676 · Jamestown & West Point Garrison (Allen 1997)

items.title: Sept 1676 · Jamestown Burned
items.detail: Bacon's rebel army burns the colonial capital; Governor Berkeley flees to warships.

items.title: West Point Joint Garrison
items.detail: Captain Thomas Grantham confronts 400 armed English and African fighters on the York River.

items.title: Deceptive Disarmament
items.detail: False pardon promises disarm the garrison; 23 leaders hanged and African fighters re-enslaved.

items.title: Allen · Engineering Patch
items.detail: The Invention of the White Race documents the planter patch to split L_white from L_black.

sources: Allen (1994, 1997), The Invention of the White Race; The Original Power, Ch. 4
